title: Trump Vows to 'Hit Iran Hard' After Tehran Strikes US Bases in Jordan and UAE
detail: President Trump said Sunday, August 30, 2026, 'We're going to hit them very hard,' after Iran launched retaliatory strikes on US military installations in Jordan and the United Arab Emirates — the first major exchange of fire in more than a month. The renewed clashes followed a US strike on Iran's Larak Island targeting rocket launchers Washington said were positioned to lay naval mines in the Strait of Hormuz. Trump said the US Navy was escorting roughly 30 ships nightly through Hormuz under 'extremely good' conditions, described Iran as a failed and economically collapsed state, and repeated a claim — raised from a prior figure of 60,000 — that Iranian authorities had killed more than 100,000 protesters, calling for the regime's leadership to be prosecuted for crimes against humanity.

media.caption: Trump vows to hit Iran hard after Tehran struck US bases in Jordan and the UAE
